decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use of the premises as a cattery shall be strictly in association with the principle use of the premises as a single-family dwellinghouse and shall be run and managed by the person(s) resident in the house.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of refuse waste and recyclable materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing of refuse, recyclables or waste shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development is considered to relate well to the character of Feltham Town centre conservation area abd would not be detrimental to the living conditions of neighbouring residents or create an unreasonable level of noise or disturbance in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 All new development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation areas, T.4.3 Traffic implication of new development of the Unitary Development Plan adopted 2003.
description: Erection of two detached outbuildings in the rear garden and use as a boarding cattery, as part of the existing residential use, to be open for business Mondays to Saturdays (08:00 - 18:00 hrs.) and Sundays (10:00 - 14:00 hrs.).
